releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.0.3 — Real-Time GitHub Releases API & Live In-App Update Engine:
- Real-Time Cloud Update Engine: Upgraded update checker to query GitHub Releases API directly, bypassing Fastly raw CDN caching for instant zero-delay update detection.
- FrameGen Zero-Lag Architecture: DwmEnableMMCSS, DwmFlush, UltraLowLatencyMode (2), and 1.0ms MMIO precision timer.
- Clean Non-Overlapping GPU Profiles View.
